question: An amount of ₹570 is divided among three persons in the ratio of 2 : 12 : 11. The difference between the largest and the smallest shares (in ₹) in the distribution is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ratio parts = 2 + 12 + 11 = 25 parts.

Value of 25 parts = ₹570.

Required ratio difference (Largest − Smallest) = 12 − 2 = 10 parts.

Difference in amount = (570 ÷ 25) × 10 = 22.8 × 10 = 228.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹228.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount to be distributed = ₹570

Ratio of distribution = 2 : 12 : 11

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total Amount = ₹570 (25x)

 
 2x

 
 12x

 
 11x

 Largest Share = 12x | Smallest Share = 2x
 Difference = 12x − 2x = 10x
 Required Difference = 10 × (570 ÷ 25) = ₹228

**Calculations:**

Let the shares of the three persons be 2x, 12x, and 11x respectively.

⇒ Total amount = 2x + 12x + 11x = 25x

⇒ 25x = 570

⇒ x = 570 ÷ 25 = 22.8

⇒ Largest share = 12x

⇒ Smallest share = 2x

⇒ Difference = 12x − 2x = 10x

⇒ Required Difference = 10 × 22.8 = 228

**∴ The correct answer is ₹228.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dividing a Quantity

If a given quantity Q is divided into multiple parts in the ratio a : b : c, then the individual portions are (a/T)×Q, (b/T)×Q, and (c/T)×Q respectively, where T is the total ratio sum (a + b + c).

Proportion Rule

When two ratios are strictly equal, they form a proportion (a : b = c : d). A key property of proportions is that the product of extremes equals the product of means (ad = bc).

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of two individual given ratios a : b and c : d is calculated by multiplying the antecedents and consequents respectively, resulting in ac : bd.
